contexts.text: The faces of the deep () = cupidities and thence falsities, from and in which he is wholly. As he has no light, he is like an abyss, or a confused dark something. Such are also called the abysses and depths of the sea in various places in the Word, which are dried up or wasted before man is being regenerated, as in .
What can be the result but an abyss of darkness?
They fall into mere falsities, thus into an abyss of darkness.
The fountains of the great deep were broken up () = the extreme of temptation as to voluntary things... The deep = cupidities and falsities thence. Illustrated. AC 845.
The deep, and many waters () = the extreme of temptation.
Waters, and the deep () = the extreme of temptation. AC 1691:5.

In ancient times, the deep meant Hell; and phantasies and false persuasions were likened to the waters and floods and also to the smoke therefrom; and so do some of the Hells appear, to wit, as deeps and as seas... That Hell is called the deep, and the filthy things thence, floods, is evident from .
The fountains of the deep, which are the Hells.
The bottomless pit () = Hell.
Rivers, waters, fountains, and deeps () = the truths thence derived.
Waters, floods, and deeps () = truths from the Lord.
The deep that lieth under () = natural things.
The beast from the bottomless pit, or Hell, shall kill them () = the vastation of good and truth within the Church.

Blessings of the deep that lieth under () = the scientifics which are in the Natural... The deep that lieth under = the scientifics in the Natural: the Natural is called the deep that lieth under relatively to interior things, which are heaven; and as the Natural is signified by the deep that lieth under, scientifics are also signified, for scientifics together with their delights are in the Natural... The deep also = scientific truths in the Natural in the blessing of Joseph ().
The deep which was round about () = the evil of falsity.
The pit of the abyss () = Hell.
The abyss out of which the locusts came = Hell.
The waters of the great deep, and the depths of the sea () = the Hell where are those who are in faith separated from charity, and in a life of evil.

The deeps have covered them () = that falsities from cupidities have overwhelmed them. The deeps = the falsities which are from cupidities. By deeps in the Word are meant waters, and the abundance of waters in the depths; and waters = truths or falsities; and the depths the Hells: hence it is that the deeps = falsities from cupidities, and also the Hells.

That the deeps in the Word mean waters in the depths, and the abundance of waters, is evident from ; etc. In these places, the deeps stand for waters in abundance; and waters in abundance, or the deeps, stand for the truths of faith in abundance. He made them drink great deeps out of the rock () = truths of faith without deficiency. The deeps going forth out of the valley and out of the mountain () = the truths of faith from love...
That the deeps = falsities from cupidities, thus also the Hells. Illustrated.
As these things are signified by the deeps, temptations are also signified by them; for temptations are effected through the injection of falsities and evils by the Hells. Illustrated.
The depths = the Hells relatively to evils; and the deeps, the Hells relatively to the falsities which come from them. Illustrated.

The deeps were congealed in the heart of the sea () = that the mere falsities from the evil of the cupidities of self-love could not at all emerge... The deeps = falsities from cupidities, and also the Hells.
The deep with which it is covered as with a garment () = scientific truth for the natural man.

There was given unto him the key of the pit of the abyss () = their Hell opened... The abyss = the Hell where are those who have confirmed with themselves justification and salvation by faith alone, who are all from the Church of the Reformed; here, however, those who, in their own eyes and thence in the eyes of many others, appear learned and erudite, when yet before the Angels in Heaven they appear bereft of understanding as to the things which are of Heaven and the Church; for they who confirm that faith even to its interiors close the higher things of their understanding, and at last to such a degree, that they can no longer see any spiritual truth in light. Explained. BE 87. BE 89.
(This pit, and the abyss below it described.) BE 89.

They had a king over them, the angel of the abyss, whose name in Hebrew is Abaddon, and in Greek he hath the name Apollyon () = that those are in the Satanic Hell who are in falsities from concupiscences, and have destroyed the Church by the total falsification of the Word... The abyss = the Satanic Hell, where these are.
They abide in the southern quarter of the abyss.
Under Beast, see this reference.

There then ascended some from the abyss who at first appeared like locusts, but afterwards like dwarfs; they were those who in the world had prayed to God the Father, and had confirmed justification by faith alone; being the same as those treated of in ... They said that they saw truths in light; but they were told that they saw them in fatuous light... which is the confirmation of falsity... and this was confirmed by the fact that when they looked up to Heaven... they saw darkness; but when they looked down to the abyss... they saw light... TCR 162.
They then retired, and let themselves down into their abyss...
When they came to their own in the abyss...

Is about to come up out of the abyss, and go into perdition () = what is sometimes deliberated in the Papal Consistory concerning the reception and reading of the Word by the laity and common people, but it is rejected... By the abyss out of which it is about to ascend nothing can be signified but that religiosity, and especially where its throne is, thus the Papal Consistory. It is an abyss, because that which is decreed there regards dominion over the holy things of the Church and over Heaven, and thus over all things of the Lord and His Word.
Having the key of the abyss () = the Divine Power of opening and shutting Hell.
His being cast into the abyss () = that they were let down towards Hell.
How singulars emulate universals, and represent the infinity of God, is an abyss, and is an ocean.
That Spirit was then sent away into the abyss treated of in , where the angels of the dragon discuss the mystical things of their faith.
Some of them fell into the abyss treated of in , which is now in the southern quarter, towards the east, where those are who confirm justification by faith alone.
The Lord's Divine wisdom they call an abyss. Now as the Word is from this abyss, because from the Lord, it is evident that there is a certain infinity in all things of it.
The Lord's Word is an abyss of truths...
The abyss () = the abode of these falsities.
When the eternal was represented as an abyss without a bottom, some who looked into its depths were struck with intense fear...
As the darkness of the abyss.

Being gathered into one they were sent into the abyss; their abyss is in the southern quarter (towards the east)... Hence it is that the dragon is said to have been sent into the abyss, and there kept bound a thousand years.

They were cast into such an abyss as opened in front of that lake, which abyss was dark, and tended deep under the sulphurous lake. In front there also opened a similar abyss, which tended underneath the other one; into this were cast those who knew about the Divine, and frequented places of worship, and yet had been in like wickedness. SE 5468, See the figure. DeConj 93.
On the abyss.

The abyss treated of in the Revelation, into which the dragon was at length cast, is completely and directly under the genitals; there appears there a great and wide cavern, black and pitch dark; thither was cast the dragon himself (Bishop Benzel.) and many who adhered to him... It is a vast gulf, and is the receptacle of the filth of the urine, but not of that of the excrement, because all there love falsities, and commingle falsities with truths.

The deeps which He bestows in treasuries () = the scientific sensuous things which are the most general and ultimate of the natural man, and simultaneously in which are interior or higher truths. AE 275:12.
To trust under the deep () = scientific truth, which is the Divine Spiritual Natural.
The blessings of the deep that lieth under () = the multiplications of truth from good in the external or natural man.
The seas and the deeps () = those who are in the ultimates (of Heaven).
The deep which was covered over him () = the Knowledges of truth... The deep, or the sea = the Scientific and Cognitive in general which is in the natural man.
Fountains = interior truths; deeps (), exterior truths.
Whales and deeps () = scientifics and Knowledges in general, or in the whole complex.
The deep () = truths in general, which are called the truths of faith.
The deep () = scientifics in general.
The deep that lieth under = spiritual natural things.
The deep that lieth under = the natural man where are the Knowledges of truth and good for perception, and scientifics which confirm.
The deeps that go forth out of the valley and out of the mountain () = the Knowledges of truth and good in the natural man, and in the Spiritual.
The deep () = the Knowledges of truth which are in the natural man.
The pit of the abyss () = the Hell where and whence are the falsities of evil.
There was given unto him the key of the pit of the abyss = communication and conjunction with the Hells... The pit of the abyss = the Hells where and whence are the falsities of evil.

And he opened the pit of the abyss = communication and conjunction with the Hells where and whence are such falsities... The reason it is called the pit of the abyss, is that a pit (or well) = the Word in the sense of the letter and the truth of doctrine thence, and in the opposite sense the Word falsified and thence falsity of doctrine; and the abyss and depth of the sea = Hell. The reason it = the Hell where are those who falsified the truths of the Word by applying them to evils of life, is that these Hells appear to those who are above like seas, and those who are there appear in their depths... AE 538.
That seas, depths, and abysses = the Hells where and whence are the falsities of evil. Illustrated.

As the abysses = the Hells where and whence are falsities, so the abysses = the ultimates of Heaven, where and whence are the Knowledges of truth, which are the truths of the natural man. The reason is that the ultimates of Heaven also appear as it were in waters, but thin and clear ones... Illustrated.
Abysses in these places = the ultimates of Heaven, in which are the spiritual natural Angels.
Moreover, abysses also = Divine truths in abundance, and the arcana of Divine Wisdom. Illustrated.
The pit of the abyss = the Hell where are they who have falsified the Word.
The abyss = Hell.
The deeps and the seas () = the Natural itself where are scientifics.
Judgments are predicated of Divine truths, which are compared to a great deep (); for the great deep = Divine truth.

Is about to come up out of the abyss, and go into perdition = the Word acknowledged as Divine for form's sake, but still rejected. To come up out of the abyss, when predicated of the Word with those who belong to Babylonia, = to be received and acknowledged as Divine for form's sake.
